name: Spire
notes: Researched from public spireenergy.com pages only. Guest payment needs the account number and mailing ZIP code and accepts card or bank. Auto Pay is under Options > Auto Pay in My Account and is free with a bank account (card Auto Pay fees not stated; methods left to family defaults). Paperless is under Options > Paperless billing with email, text or both. Stop service is online in My Account (Schedule Service > Stop Service with stop date and final-bill address). A five-month online payment arrangement was reported from a search snippet, but the official payment-arrangements page returns Access denied to the public, so the length is not claimed and payment_arrangement is marked inferred (review 2026-10-09). The FAQ refers to a My Account username and password (changed under Profile & settings), so the identifier is username. Card fees and MFA are not documented publicly (family defaults). Mail addresses differ by region. Review 2026-10-09: user-facing capability notes reworded to drop research wording ("assumed"/"inferred"); evidence levels unchanged.

help.title: Ways to pay your Spire bill
paragraphs: Registered users can make a one-time payment in My Account with a debit or credit card or a bank account. Without signing in, Pay as a guest takes the same methods and asks for your account number and mailing ZIP code.

You can also pay through the automated phone system at any hour, mail a payment to the address on your bill (it differs by region), or pay at a payment location; some cash locations charge a small fee.

help.title: Auto Pay
paragraphs: Auto Pay takes your bill from your account each month and is free when you pay from a bank account.
In My Account, choose Options, then Auto Pay, pick or add a payment method, accept the terms and select Confirm Auto Pay. A confirmation number appears and is emailed to you.
steps: Pick a saved payment method or add one.
Accept the terms and select Confirm Auto Pay.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: In My Account choose Options, then Paperless billing, pick Email, Text or Both for notifications, check your contact details and select Save. Your statements then arrive in your inbox.

help.title: Payment assistance and Budget Billing
paragraphs: If you are having trouble paying, Spire points customers to payment assistance programs, which differ by region (Alabama, Mississippi, eastern and western Missouri). Contact Spire to ask about a payment arrangement for a past-due balance.
Budget Billing keeps your monthly payment steady. Your balance must be zero before you enroll; then review the monthly amount shown in My Account and select Enroll.

help.title: Stop service
paragraphs: In My Account open Schedule Service, choose Stop Service, and enter your service address, the stop date and the address where your final bill should go.
steps: Enter the stop date and final-bill address and submit.
